parents: PR926 authenticated adapter transition source/topology binding

proposals.name: at_use_dual_parent_recompute_plus_cross_binding
proposals.consequence: Transition and process owners remain separate; activation is admitted only when exact core/source/topology/runtime/dispatch identities agree at use.

proposals.name: trust_two_ready_booleans
proposals.rejection: Two valid parent proofs can refer to different loaded adapter worlds.

proposals.name: fold_adapter_identity_into_process_owner
proposals.rejection: Duplicates transition/source/topology ownership and couples generic process attestation to AWJ032 semantics.

proposals.name: fold_process_identity_into_transition_authority
proposals.rejection: Lets transition authority mint process currentness and cannot handle hot reload/fork/worker movement cleanly.

proposals.name: new_central_activation_authority_server
proposals.rejection: Creates a third authority owner when a pure cross-binding witness is sufficient.
